# Lance JSON contracts and Arrow StringView reference

Regenerate with `pixi run python scripts/lance_json_reference.py`.
The executable compiles Lance's unchanged `rust/lance-arrow/src/json.rs` at
`ad2ee27f0f0ad2cd4d756b85214b5a7e5dc1b06e` and links jsonb 0.5.6 with default
features off / databend on, matching Lance's declared dependency. The exact
reference Cargo.lock is retained; this does not infer every possible feature
union of a complete Lance server build.

`contracts.json` records 5,641 raw-byte inputs through actual jsonb extended and
standard entry points. It preserves typed trees, exact F64 bit patterns, source
text rendering and errors, plus original Lance null handling and storage-type
detection. Extended accepts 3,426 and rejects 2,215; standard accepts 3,397 and
rejects 2,244; neither panics on this corpus. Source behavior is evidence, not
a claim that Akasha already implements jsonb or either complete product.

`stringview.arrow` is generated by actual Arrow 58.4.0 StringViewBuilder and IPC.
Eight sliced rows cover null/empty, 12/13-byte boundary, multibyte Unicode, NUL
and multiple backing blocks. The native/public Arrow tests consume this fixture
and compare against the original strings, including restart and output schemas.

The generator pins 15 source dependencies to Lance's lock and verifies their
archives and 411 Rust source files. Hashes, licenses, upstreams, helper/scaffold
identity and fixture hashes are in `sources.json`. Rust remains reference-only;
the StringView traversal/materialization runs in Mojo.
